跟着做：一条生产线长什么样: Follow Along: What a Production Line Looks Like
这一课你看到了一条线的全部：来料、加工、缓存、输送、检测、入库。下一课要在图上把: In this lesson, you'll see the whole line: incoming material, machining, buffers, conveyors, inspection, and storage. In the next lesson, you'll identify each one on the diagram.
这是一条加工**法兰盘**的小生产线。你要做的很简单：让它跑起来，看零件从左边走:
This is a small production line for machining **flanges**. Your task is simple: start it, watch parts move from left to right, then answer 3 questions.
**Success criteria**: Answer all 3 questions correctly and earn 100 points after submitting.
先看懂一条线是怎么流动的，后面的课都在这条线上做。: First, understand how parts flow through a line. You'll use this line in the lessons that follow.
如果工作台左上角写着「已暂停」，点第二行的「**运行**」。等右上角的仿真时钟走: If the top-left corner of the Workbench says "Paused," click "**Run**" in the second row. Wait until the simulation clock advances by **5 minutes** (the speed is set to 10× for this lesson, so it takes about half a minute).
仿真时钟是工厂里的时间；倍速越大，现实里等得越短。: The simulation clock shows factory time. The higher the speed, the less time you wait in real life.
运行按钮在工作台顶上第二行，「重置」右边。旁边的倍速可以调成 60×。: The Run button is in the second row at the top of the Workbench, to the right of "Reset." You can set the speed next to it to 60×.
顶上切到「**三维**」。从左往右找：**毛坯来料 → 1#数控车床 → 2#加: Switch to "**3D**" at the top. Follow the line from left to right: **raw casting incoming → #1 CNC Lathe → #2 Machining Center → Conveyor → In-Line Inspection → Finished Goods Warehouse**. The small signs above the equipment show its name and current status. When you're done, click "Next."
三维就是车间的样子，设备摆在哪、零件怎么走，一眼就能看到。: The 3D view shows the workshop layout, where the equipment is, and how parts move through the line.
点「带我去」选中 **在线检测**。合格的零件往右进成品仓库；不合格的往下进**: Click "Take me there" to select **Online Inspection**. Accepted parts move right to the finished goods warehouse; rejected parts move down to the **Scrap Bin**. When you're done, click "Next."
检测设备不加工零件，只判断合格不合格，把不合格的分出去。: The inspection station does not process parts. It only checks whether they pass and diverts rejected parts.
换成流程图再看一遍: Switch to the process flow and take another look
顶上切到「**流程**」。每个方块是一台设备，箭头是零件走的路；和三维里是同一批: Switch to "**Process Flow**" at the top. Each block represents a machine, and the arrows show the part's route. These are the same machines as in the 3D view. When you're done, click "Next."
流程图把车间画成方块和箭头，设备再多也看得清先后顺序。: The process flow shows the workshop as blocks and arrows, making the sequence easy to follow, even with many machines.
打开任务面板的「**目标与作答**」，3 道题都选好。: Open "**Objectives & Answers**" in the task panel and answer all 3 questions.
这 3 道题考的就是刚才看到的：顺序、缓存、不合格品去哪。: These 3 questions cover what you just saw: the sequence, the buffer, and where rejected parts go.
缓存只是临时放零件的地方，它不加工，也不检测。: A buffer is only a temporary place to hold parts. It does not process or inspect them.
点任务面板上绿色的「**提交评分**」。: Click the green "**Submit for Grading**" button in the task panel.
